board_status: Empty by design. 0 strategies are registered and 0 bets have been settled. An empty board is the correct rendering of a project that has not yet made a bet it can be judged on.

divisions.name: Game parlays
divisions.eligible: Two or more legs across different games

divisions.name: Same-game parlays
divisions.eligible: Two or more legs within one game

divisions.name: Prop combos
divisions.blocked_by: Q-CORR-01 and the absence of prop line history

joint_evidence_gate.rule: A combo may be ranked only when (a) a directly validated joint probability exists for that specific combination, measured on settled data with n published, and (b) the operator's void and push rules for that combination are on file.
joint_evidence_gate.prohibited: Multiplying marginal probabilities. Under dependence it is invalid, and in same-game parlays dependence is the whole problem.
joint_evidence_gate.why: A product of marginals is not a conservative estimate; it is a different quantity. Publishing it would produce a ranking that rewards the modelling error the gate exists to prevent.

ranking.rank_key: Benchmark-relative Brier skill score, with a game-cluster lower bound used as the ranking statistic and a multiplicity adjustment for the number of strategies tried.
ranking.why_not_win_rate: Win rate cannot separate a good process from a good run at any realistic sample size, and it ignores the price taken. Two strategies with identical win rates can have opposite expected value.
ranking.why_not_roi: Season-long ROI is the ranked metric this project explicitly rejects. Short-run ROI is dominated by variance and by stake size, so ranking on it selects for luck and for bold staking.
ranking.uncertainty: Every published skill score carries an interval from a bootstrap clustered by game, so bets on the same game do not pretend to be independent observations.
ranking.multiplicity: The adjustment uses a journal of all variants tried, including the failed ones. A leaderboard that only sees survivors measures the author's persistence, not the strategy's skill.
ranking.note_on_display_only: These columns are shown for context and cannot move the rank, which is how a lucky staking run is prevented from masking a bad signal.

signal_vs_staking.rule: Signal is scored and ranked. Staking is recorded and displayed. The two never mix in the rank key.
signal_vs_staking.why: A strategy with a mediocre signal and an aggressive staking schedule can post the best return in any short sample. Ranking signal separately means the leaderboard answers 'is this a good forecast', not 'did this get lucky with size'.
signal_vs_staking.enforcement: The builder rejects any ranking expression containing a stake field.

stage_1.name: Proper-score qualification
stage_1.purpose: Decide whether the strategy forecasts better than the benchmark at all, before any money concept is introduced.
entry_tests: Pre-registration recorded with a commit hash before the evaluation window opens
Chronological evaluation only; no fold trains on a later date
Benchmark-relative Brier skill above the qualification bar, with the game-cluster lower bound above zero
Input-perturbation robustness: the skill survives perturbing each input within its measurement error
No-lookahead timestamp rule: every input timestamp is strictly earlier than the forecast timestamp, which is strictly earlier than kickoff
Sample floor met, counted in settled bets across distinct games

stage_2.name: Prospective CLV and ROI escrow
stage_2.purpose: Confirm the qualified skill converts into beating the closing line, prospectively, on bets that were recorded before kickoff.
entry_tests: Stage 1 passed, with the result and its interval published
A market price exists for every bet scored (Q-PRICE-01)
Closing-line value measured against the stored closing price, per bet, with n published
A prospective window agreed before the window opens; the window's bets are escrowed, not selected afterwards

control_baselines.rule: Every leaderboard run, in every division, includes the two controls below. A strategy must beat the relevant control to be ranked at all.

controls.name: Random picks
controls.description: A coin-flip selection over the same markets in the same window, run with the same number of bets.
controls.purpose: Establishes what pure chance looks like in this specific window and sample size.

controls.name: Favourites only
controls.description: Always take the market favourite, using the market line as the favourite's identity, run over the same markets.
controls.purpose: Beating 'always back the favourite' is a much higher bar than beating zero, and it is the bar that actually matters.

control_baselines.note: CTL-FAV needs a market line, so it becomes runnable at the same time as stage 2 (Q-PRICE-01). CTL-RAND is runnable now but is not informative without prices to score against.

demotion_gate.rule: A live strategy is sent back to paper automatically when either trigger fires. Neither requires a human to notice.

triggers.name: Closing-line value decay
triggers.test: Trailing CLV over the agreed window falls below the demotion floor, with the game-cluster upper bound also below the floor.
triggers.why_null: Threshold must be set before the first live run. An unset threshold fails closed, which is the intended behaviour.

triggers.name: Calibration break
triggers.test: The forecast probabilities and the observed outcomes diverge beyond the calibration tolerance on the trailing window, judged by a proper score rather than by win rate.

demotion_gate.on_demotion: The strategy returns to paper, the demotion is logged with the window and the test that fired, and it may only return after a new pre-registration. A demoted strategy is never silently re-promoted when the number recovers.

pre_registration.rule: The registration is the commit. Rule text, sample window and gates are committed before the evaluation window opens; the commit hash is the registration.

registered.name: Singles-only shadow baseline (team strength)
registered.rule_text: A simple team-strength model on singles only, no stake, run in shadow. It exists to prove the leaderboard plumbing works and to provide the first benchmark.
registered.note: Registration recorded in the commit that introduced this file. It has not run, because its inputs require a rating that is deliberately unfitted (Q-MODEL-03). It is a shadow baseline for this section only; the 16 strategies registered in prereg/ belong to the signals section and are not duplicated here.

pre_registration.note: Backtest numbers can never appear on the leaderboard. The leaderboard scores only bets registered before the settlement they are scored against, and the builder rejects any row that violates this.
pre_registration.canonical: The repository's canonical pre-registration is prereg/REGISTRATION.md on main (registration 2026-11-16), which freezes data/signals/{strategies,gates,leaderboard,correlations}.json with file hashes checked on every build. This page is the lab's decision-first view of the same rules and does not supersede it. Where the two disagree, the frozen registration wins until a new dated registration is committed.

anti_gaming.rule: Registration timestamp must be strictly earlier than the first bet timestamp it scores.
A strategy may not be edited inside its own evaluation window. The edit creates a new strategy with a new registration.
Failed variants are recorded in the multiplicity journal. Deleting a failed variant is a reporting violation, not a tidy-up.
Rewards are non-cash. A cash reward converts a research leaderboard into a staking competition and selects for variance.
No capital is exposed at any stage until stage 1 and stage 2 both pass prospectively.

tiers.name: Qualified
tiers.reward: Published with the result and interval

tiers.name: Ranked
tiers.test: Beats the relevant control baseline on the rank key

tiers.name: Promoted
tiers.reward: Eligible for live tracking, still non-cash

tiers.name: Reserved
tiers.test: Sustains tier 3 across two windows without a demotion trigger
tiers.reward: Named owner credit in the register

tiers.name: Benchmark
tiers.test: Becomes the new benchmark other strategies are measured against
tiers.reward: Benchmark status; replaces CTL-FAV for future windows

rewards.note: No monetary value is attached to any tier. Nothing here is a prize, and nothing here is betting advice.
